cs2Loadouts.label: Project 1
cs2Loadouts.title: Streamer CS2 loadouts
cs2Loadouts.subtitle: The first StreamersItems collection — iconic skins and knives from streamers you follow. Tap a slot to mark it collected.

p1BusterGoldAk.description: A full-gold AK from Buster’s on-stream flex loadout — the kind of skin chat spams «inspect» for.
p1BusterGoldAk.funFact: Gold Arabesque drops from Operation Riptide cases — one of the few AK finishes that looks like jewelry in inspect.

p1DonkKnife.description: donk’s butterfly doppler is basically a highlight reel accessory: flashy, loud, and always center stage.
p1DonkKnife.funFact: Butterfly knives have a unique flip animation — CS2 players call it free morale before the first duel.

p1S1mpleAwp.description: The Dragon Lore AWP linked with s1mple’s legacy — a trophy-skin energy even as a showcase piece.
p1S1mpleAwp.funFact: Dragon Lore is a Cobblestone collection skin; real souvenir versions can sell for more than a compact car.

p1ShroudM4.description: Shroud’s clean Printstream M4 fits his «headshot first, chat second» aesthetic on custom servers.
p1ShroudM4.funFact: Printstream uses a monochrome sci-fi print that stays readable in both bright and dark maps.

p1OverdriveGloves.description: Neon Vice gloves from m0NESY’s CS2 wardrobe — gloves that steal the killfeed spotlight.
p1OverdriveGloves.funFact: Sport Gloves changed how players match skins: full loadouts are often built around glove color first.

p1StarterUsp.description: Buster’s starter USP — not the flashiest gun, but every inventory legend begins with pistol rounds.
p1StarterUsp.funFact: Ticket to Hell is a community favorite for budget blue loadouts — cheap entry, big personality.

tarkovLoot.label: Project 2
tarkovLoot.title: Streamer Tarkov loot
tarkovLoot.subtitle: Raid staples and flex finds from Escape from Tarkov creators — bitcoins, LEDX, Labs keys, and stash porn. Tap a slot to mark it collected.

p2LvndmarkBitcoin.description: LVNDMARK’s Physical Bitcoin — the loot chat treats like a slot machine jackpot every wipe.
p2LvndmarkBitcoin.funFact: Bitcoins spawn on maps and in safes; streamers often price them in «how many kits» instead of roubles.

p2PestilyLedx.description: Pestily’s LEDX hunt energy — the medical loot that turns a «quick labs» into a highlight reel.
p2PestilyLedx.funFact: LEDX is a Therapist task item and one of the highest-value medical spawns in the game.

p2SummitRedKeycard.description: summit1g and the Red Keycard — Labs access as content, with extra sweat when the timer’s ticking.
p2SummitRedKeycard.funFact: Red keycards open the main Labs loot rooms; they’re single-use and brutally contested.

p2VeritasThicc.description: Veritas flexing a T H I C C Items case — stash organization as streamer personality.
p2VeritasThicc.funFact: THICC cases hold a massive grid; they’re endgame storage flex and a long-term economy sink.

p2JesseSlick.description: JesseKazam’s Slick — min-max armor that still looks clean on the death replay.
p2JesseSlick.funFact: The Slick has high durability with no mag penalty — a go-to for lightweight meta builds.

p2SlobGrizzly.description: DeadlySlob’s Grizzly — old-school healing that every veteran remembers from early wipes.
p2SlobGrizzly.funFact: Grizzlies heal a huge chunk over time; they’re bulky but forgiving when you’re learning maps.

inventory.title: Cyber inventory
inventory.subtitle: Interactive streamer item slots — rarity glow, tilt, glitch on vault items. Tap a slot to mark it collected.
inventory.hint: Neon live dot = streamer online. Legendary and secret items glitch on hover.
